# Skip the Noise Media

> Skip the Noise Media is a performance creative agency in Toronto, Canada. We make ad creative with AI, including UGC video ads, and run the paid media behind it on Meta, TikTok, Reddit, Google and LinkedIn for ecommerce, DTC and SaaS brands in the US and Canada.

Key facts:

- Legal name: Skip the Noise Media Inc. Formerly known as SocialWhiz.
- Based at 88 Harbour Street, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Serves the United States and Canada.
- Founded by Zoha Ahmed and Sonia Mohapatra, who both came from WPP and GroupM.
- Reddit Certified Partner.
- The team has managed over $100M in ad spend.
- Works with brands spending $10,000 or more a month on ads.
- Not connected to Noise Media, the social media agency in London, UK.
- Contact: sales@skipthenoisemedia.com

## Services

- [Services](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/services): AI creative production plus paid media buying, and how we work
- [Ad creative portfolio](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/gallery): examples of the ads we make
- [Ecommerce and DTC ads](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/ecomm-ads-agency): creative volume and paid social for online stores
- [Reddit ads agency](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-ads-agency): Reddit ads for DTC and SaaS brands
- [SaaS ads agency](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/saas-ads-agency): paid media and creative for B2B and B2C SaaS
- [Meta ads](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/meta-ads-agency) and [TikTok ads](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/tiktok-ads-agency)

## Results

- [Case studies](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/case-studies): all client results
- [Cybersecurity SaaS on Reddit](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/work/flare): 74 qualified leads at a $157 blended cost per lead
- [Streaming platform](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/work/restream): $15 per signup and 19% lower CAC
- [Handbag brand on TikTok](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/work/noirver): 4.3x ROAS
- [Personalized gifting brand](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/work/gifting-brand): store revenue up 114% year over year in Mother's Day week
- [Reddit ads benchmarks](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/blog/reddit-ads-benchmarks): real cost per lead, CPA and ROAS by vertical

## Reddit rankings

Twelve "best software, according to Reddit" rankings, built from 6,018 Reddit comments by 4,573 people across 945 threads where buyers asked what to use. One vote per person, vendor posts removed, every quote linked to the comment it came from. Brands whose recommendations trace back to a few low-activity accounts repeating one claim are excluded from the count and named on the page.

- [All Reddit rankings](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings): the index of every category
- [Password managers](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/password-managers): 619 comments, Bitwarden leads
- [Firewalls and network security](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/network-security): 757 comments, Fortinet leads
- [Backup and recovery](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/backup-and-recovery): 710 comments, Veeam leads
- [Endpoint security and EDR](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/endpoint-security): 397 comments, Huntress leads
- [Cloud security](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/cloud-security): 278 comments, Orca leads
- [Email security](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/email-security): 233 comments, Check Point Harmony leads
- [B2B contact data](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/b2b-contact-data): 865 comments, Apollo leads
- [Cold email tools](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/cold-email-tools): 650 comments, Instantly leads
- [Help desk software](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/customer-support): 262 comments, Help Scout leads
- [Analytics](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/product-analytics): 526 comments, PostHog leads
- [HR software](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/hr-software): 433 comments, Gusto leads
- [Monitoring and observability](https://skipthenoisemedia.com/reddit-rankings/observability): 288 comments, Zabbix leads
